# Refusal & Route Surface Requirements Checklist: Application shell and cross-cutting UX

**Purpose**: Validate that the guard, refusal, absence and sign-out requirements are complete, internally consistent and verifiable before `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope**: The route surface this feature registers, the order in which each route decides, what a refusal and an absence say, and the one mutating request. Rendering of the refusal screen as a screen is in [ux.md](ux.md).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the set of admin-only routes enumerable from this specification, given that SC-014 requires checking "each admin-only route in the surface table"? [Gap, Spec §SC-014, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK002 Does the surface table carry the Access column that the registration sentence beneath it refers to, or does that sentence point at a column this document does not contain? [Conflict, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK003 Is the response status of a refusal and of an absence specified, or is only the visible wording required? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK004 Is "the error code" the Forbidden screen shows identified anywhere in the specification? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK005 Is the Forbidden screen's "one sentence of explanation" fixed verbatim, as FR-022's wording is? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK006 Is clearing the browser's session cookie stated as a requirement of sign-out, or only implied by SC-013's "no request from that browser is answered as them afterwards"? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, §SC-013]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified whether sign-out ends only the caller's session or every session that user holds? Both readings satisfy the words "end the caller's session". [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK008 Is the answer given to a sign-out request whose stated origin is not the installation's own specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK009 Is preservation of the requested destination across the sign-in redirect specified, or deliberately excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements stated for a session that is present but expired, as distinct from a request carrying no session at all? US3 s4 assumes the two behave alike; no requirement says so. [Gap, Spec §FR-021, US3 s4]
- [x] CHK011 Is the enforcement point stated as the route itself, ruling out a shared pre-route filter being read as sufficient? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Does FR-028's "every screen MUST be reachable at the route the table assigns it" conflict with `/invite/accept` deliberately not answering until entry R3? [Conflict, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK013 Does the Forbidden screen disclose to a member that a route exists, in a way SC-008's "nothing suggests a hidden room" forbids for the absence case? Is the asymmetry deliberate and recorded? [Conflict, Spec §FR-019, §FR-029, §SC-008, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK014 Is FR-029's authorization-before-existence order stated for routes carrying no role restriction, or only for admin-only ones? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK015 Do FR-014's "every route MUST perform its own authorization check" and FR-021's authentication redirect use "authorization" consistently, so a route restricted only by sign-in is unambiguously covered? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK016 Do FR-020 (Forbidden has no route of its own) and FR-028 (no route outside the table answers) leave the Forbidden row's "no route" entry unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §FR-028]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can SC-014 be verified at all without a stated list of admin-only routes to check against? [Measurability, Spec §SC-014, CHK001]
- [x] CHK018 Is SC-007's "0% of the time" verifiable against an enumerable set of authenticated routes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK019 Is SC-013's "no request from that browser is answered as them afterwards" bounded to a checkable set of requests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-013]
- [x] CHK020 Is FR-016's "MUST remove no rows" verifiable in a feature that owns no rows, and is US2 s5's "no row they authored has been removed" testable here? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, US2 s5]
- [x] CHK021 Is SC-006's "reaches Home in one click" stated as a requirement on the Forbidden screen's content, and is that action required to be operable by keyboard? [Traceability, Spec §SC-006, §FR-019, §FR-031]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are requirements stated for an unclaimed path beneath a guarded prefix — does it refuse or report absence, and does FR-029's ordering reach a path no screen claims? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-022, §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a route parameter that is syntactically invalid, as distinct from one naming a record that is absent? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK024 Is behaviour specified for a role change that lands between the guard's decision and the render? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements stated for two sign-out requests issued concurrently on the same session, given FR-018 requires quiet success on an already-ended one? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK026 Is any record of a refusal or a sign-out required, or is the absence of an audit requirement deliberate? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements stated for an authenticated caller who requests the sign-in screen, given the sign-in surface sits outside the shell? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 Is the boundary between entry R1's redirect and this feature's route group stated clearly enough that neither entry assumes the other tests it? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that authorization reduces to `isAdmin` and `isMember` validated against every guard this feature registers, including the routes whose screens arrive later? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK030 Is the dependency on entry R1's session deletion stated with the behaviour this feature relies on — including its response when the session is already gone? [Assumption, Spec §FR-018, §Dependencies]

## Notes

- **Assisted evaluation pass, 2026-08-30.** At the reviewer's request, every item was scanned against `spec.md` and marked `[x]` only where a specific sentence in that document answered it. 32 of the 91 items across the three checklists were already satisfied; the remaining 59 were then resolved by amending `spec.md` — no requirement was added or removed, every amendment landed inside an existing FR, and the resolutions narrow `docs/product/specifications.md` rather than inventing product decisions. Where the source is silent the resolution is recorded under *Assumptions* as a default. Marks are the agent's reading and remain the reviewer's to overturn.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001, CHK002 and CHK017 are one finding seen from three sides: the registration sentence promises a guard "its Access column implies", and the table printed in this spec has no such column. Resolving CHK002 likely resolves the other two.
